10681.title: WALL·E
10681.overview: After hundreds of years doing what he was built for, WALL•E— a robot designed to clean up the earth—discovers a new purpose in life when he meets a sleek search robot named EVE. EVE comes to realize that WALL•E has inadvertently stumbled upon the key to the planet's future, and races back to space to report to the humans. Meanwhile, WALL•E chases EVE across the galaxy and sets into motion one of the most imaginative adventures ever brought to the big screen.

22649.title: A Farewell to Arms
22649.overview: A tale of the World War I love affair, begun in Italy, between American ambulance driver Lt. Frederic Henry and British nurse Catherine Barkley. Eventually separated by Frederic's transfer, tremendous challenges and difficult decisions face each as the war rages on.

610361.title: You're Fired
610361.overview: Max is a young and nimble provincial, not particularly burdened by morals and principles, energetically making a successful career in Moscow. He works in a recruitment agency, and his specialization is to fire top managers, help squeeze out shares in companies, and similar routine business issues. Max’s next task is to get rid of Georgy, the chief programmer of a large IT company. At first glance, work for a couple of days, because who is Gregory? A bearded boy under 40, the embodiment of simplicity and harmlessness. But it turns out that this is a unique case, and it is incredibly difficult to fire Gregory. Especially considering what a charming half-sister he has. Max has to go through a lot of funny, touching and dangerous trials that will help him understand that there are other values in life besides career, money and real estate.

667705.title: The Woman Who Cannot Feel
667705.overview: Tasha is a woman diagnosed with Congenital Insensitivity to Pain. This condition makes her incapable of feeling pain – be it physical or emotional pain. And because of her condition, she also has no idea how love works. Until she meets Ngongo, a man with cleft palate. Ngongo becomes an instrument who made Tasha feel again, especially the joys of love and pains of heartache. And together, they experience an adventure that they will never forget.

677561.title: The Legendaries
677561.overview: They are brave, intrepid, indomitable, and they turned back to children! While fighting the terrible sorcerer Darkhell, the official heros of Alysia: The Legendaries accidentally broke the Jovenia stone, the one of eternal youth. This is how the whole kingdom of Alysia, and especially our champions, has fallen back into childhood. No more birth, but people keep on dying of accident or sickness… Humanity is then doomed to extinction. A real curse! And quite a blow to the myth of "The Legendaries". The five warriors, formerly admired, have now to lie low… Today blamed and discredited, they are well decided to break the spell and fix their mistake. "Nothing is impossible for a willing heart"… Even at 10!

952569.title: Born in the USSR: 35 Up
952569.overview: The documentary series "Born in the USSR" is a unique chronology which began in 1989 and has continued for more than 30 years. The authors follow 20 children from different Republics of the former Soviet Union revisiting their life stories every seven years. The new film focuses on the age of 35 years, the time of adulthood and re-evaluation when a man finds himself at the "midpoint" of his life. This is a series about the coming of age of a generation, the search for oneself, about the human being undergoing changes in the changing world.

1084409.title: A Talent for Murder
1084409.overview: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

1109369.title: Kathanar - The Wild Sorcerer
1109369.overview: Based on the tales of Kadamattathu Kathanar, the legendary priest who is believed to have lived in Kadamattom and possessed supernatural powers.

1128377.title: In Cold Light
1128377.overview: Fresh out of prison, Ava's attempt to reclaim her drug operation collapses when she witnesses a brutal crime, forcing her to flee into a nightmarish underworld where allies are scarce and enemies multiply by the minute.

1139129.title: Arachnado 2: Flaming Spiders
1139129.overview: Just when you thought it couldn't get any worse, the Arachnado has returned, this time as a "Firenado" with Flaming Spiders. It's up to a renegade Sergeant Preston and the Janitor from the original film to overthrow the corrupt Lieutenant Gallagher and put the fire out.

1163193.title: A Dance with Rainbows
1163193.overview: At 20, Ling balances boxing and helping with her mother's lunchbox business, all while her family quietly unravels. Her parents fake harmony, but when her father brings home a new "girlfriend," the illusion is shattered. Refusing to look away, Ling endures the blows - bloodied and tear-streaked. In facing reality head-on, she discovers a deeper truth: only with honesty in her heart do her punches carry real weight.

1165369.title: De Gaulle: Liberté
1165369.overview: Part two of a two-part biopic following French army officer Charles De Gaulle's life and political commitment between 1940 and 1945, and trace his development towards a political career.
1165369.trailerName: DE GAULLE: FILM 2 - LIBERTÉ - Official Trailer HD
1165369.original_title: La Bataille de Gaulle : J’écris ton nom

1176953.title: Gepellte Haut
1176953.overview: Four young people from Berlin decide to spend their summer in Portugal. They throw away their smart phones, open up their relationships and try to free themselves from any social norms. But just as their utopia comes true, a devastating forest fire breaks out around them.

1177529.title: Deathgasm 2: Goremageddon
1177529.overview: After failing to reform his heavy metal band DEATHGASM for a battle-of-the-bands to win back his girlfriend Medina, Brodie decides to use black magic to raise his ex-band members Zakk and Dion from the dead. However, his resurrected friends become unpredictable and dangerous, leading to chaos in the town.

1187129.title: Unwinding
1187129.overview: When the son of a Senator goes missing, private investigator Gaven Mori is hired by the family to piece together and solve the mystery.

1232569.title: Pinocchio: Unstrung
1232569.overview: Influenced by a sinister Cricket and created by Geppetto, Pinocchio launches a violent crusade to carve himself into a real boy like his brother James, one piece at a time.
1232569.trailerName: Pinocchio: Unstrung (2026) - Official Trailer | Horror | Robert Englund, Richard Brake

1235769.title: The Journey to Gyeong-ju
1235769.overview: Eight years ago, the youngest daughter, Gyeong-ju, disappeared during a school field trip to Gyeongju and never came home alive.  On what would have been her birthday, her mother Ok-sil and her three daughters—Jang-ju, Young-ju, and Dong-ju—put on matching family T-shirts and set off for Gyeongju, the place where Gyeong-ju vanished, in what appears to be a family trip to honor her memory. But beneath the cheerful façade lies a deadly secret. In the trunk of their van is a bound and unconscious man zipped inside a plastic bag.
1235769.trailerName: The Journey to Gyeong-ju | Official Teaser Trailer | INTL

1236153.title: Mercy
1236153.overview: In the near future, a detective stands on trial accused of murdering his wife. He has ninety minutes to prove his innocence to the advanced AI Judge he once championed, before it determines his fate.

1236857.title: Liberated from Paradise: Resonance of the Heart
1236857.overview: Anime movie sequel of Expelled from Paradise.
1236857.original_title: 楽園追放 心のレゾナンス

1240889.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
1240889.overview: After years of slapdash sequels, the Camp Miasma franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original’s star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.
1240889.original_title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma

1242937.title: The Dreadful
1242937.overview: In medieval England, Anne and her domineering mother-in-law Morwen struggle to survive on the outskirts of society. But when a man from Anne's past returns from war, a curse begins to take shape through a mysterious knight and threatens to destroy them all.

1261049.title: The Opera! Arias for an Eclipse
1261049.overview: A sudden gunshot shatters the dream of two lovers on their wedding day. The fate of Orpheus and Eurydice is cruel: on the very day they sought to seal their love, EurydiceΆs soul embarks on its journey to the underworld. Heartbroken, Orpheus embarks on a perilous journey to bring his beloved back from Hades. A journey that will lead the fearless hero to confront the depths of his emotions and face his greatest fears. This journey will take him through strange worlds and into encounters with some of the greatest musical pieces and arias in the history of music. Will love triumph over death?

1266041.title: X502C
1266041.overview: Set in an unknown space and time, a hyperconnected world dominated by technological dogmas, wireless cities and near total collapse, where there are no differences between human and machine, Thom will search for answers in his own history, hoping to preserve his remaining humanity.

1279865.title: A New Dawn
1279865.overview: The Obinata Fireworks Shop factory is getting prepared for an administrative action for confiscation tomorrow. It has been six years since Keitaro has been holed up in a closed-down factory creating fireworks by himself, chasing after an illusion of his father who vanished. It is a story about three young people who overcome the extreme weather conditions, disasters and environmental problems imposed on them and establish their own identities.

1304313.title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
1304313.overview: The young daughter of a journalist disappears into the desert without a trace—eight years later, the broken family is shocked when she is returned to them, as what should be a joyful reunion turns into a living nightmare.

1359353.title: The Dead Place
1359353.overview: Troubled high school senior Isaac [Veliu] is plagued by visions of the dead. This causes friction in his family and makes him an outcast at school. His only friend Katharine [Graves] is obsessed with the paranormal and tries desperately to help him, but a ‘New Kid’ [Thornton] pushes him to give in to the demon trying to burrow its way inside him [Oberst]. As he is consumed by the evil feeding off the dead souls that haunt him, Katharine is the only one that stands between Isaac and his darker impulses. To satisfy the bloodlust of the demon that dwells within him.
1359353.trailerName: The DEAD PLACE starring David Howard Thornton OFFICIAL TRAILER

1375161.title: Don't Move
1375161.overview: A church group's annual retreat turns deadly when they wander into the wrong part of the Ozark wilderness, and something starts picking them off one by one.  Suspicion falls on Ricky, the troublemaker of the group. But the real threat is far worse.  Deep in the forest, wrapped in a labyrinth of webs, the group is pursued by a terrifying prehistoric arachnid that hunts by vibration. When every step could be their last, they only have one choice: Don't Move.  It's up to Megan to hold what's left of the group together and get them out alive.

1389241.title: The Absent
1389241.overview: The first work written and directed by Xinjiang female director Lu Dan uses a delicate technique to tell the story of a Russian photographer who has been away from his hometown for a long time, a Han girl who wanders around looking for her father, and a lonely Tatar accordionist in a northern town in winter. A story of unexpected encounters.
1389241.trailerName: MINT CFF 2025 Trailer of The Absent 冬旅人 （2024）

1389881.title: The Cure
1389881.overview: An adopted 16-year-old with a mysterious illness learns her bio-tech billionaire parents are harvesting her blood for nefarious purposes.

1394041.overview: 77 / 5.000  The Disney Channel interactive cinema will be back on the big screen in 2025!

1400761.title: Didn't Die

1405945.title: Covil
1405945.overview: A young woman inherits a house marked by family disputes and discovers a room concealing a terrifying secret, which triggers a journey into a dark and mysterious legacy.

1410937.title: Balan - The Boy
1410937.overview: A teenage boy searches for his missing mother following a turbulent childhood and her subsequent disappearance, exploring his search for closure and the truth about his past.

1411193.title: Ninja Motherf*cking Destruction
1411193.overview: At 18, Leonie and Marlene are best friends, convinced that nothing in the world can tear them apart. But then Leonie falls in love with Naomi, and as she immerses herself in her first great love, she drifts further away from Marlene. However, Leonie increasingly finds the relationship with Naomi overwhelming, and only after their breakup does she realize how much she has isolated herself. She leaves Berlin and starts training as a gardener in Brandenburg, hoping to sort out her feelings and the world around her. But the past years have left their mark on everyone.

1411577.title: Number One
1411577.overview: Eighteen-year-old Ha-min suddenly begins to see the number "365" every time he eats his mother's homemade meal—and the number drops with each bite. Believing it to be a countdown to his mother's death, he distances himself from her and her cooking. Years later, still haunted by the number, Ha-min lives cautiously, preparing for the worst. Just as he begins to find peace with his girlfriend Ryeo-eun, an unexpected truth turns his world upside down.

1413113.title: Cry to Heaven
1413113.overview: Set in 18th-century Venice, the paths of two unlikely collaborators: a Venetian noble and a castrated singer from Calabria, both tries to succeed in the world of the opera.

1414009.title: Oki & Nirmala
1414009.overview: Set in a magical fairytale land, this story follows the adventures of Oki—a cheerful yet clumsy ten-year-old green dwarf—and Nirmala, a graceful and kind-hearted forest fairy whose magic wand is always ready to help.

1417849.title: Naari Naari Naduma Murari
1417849.overview: A young man's life turns upside down when he finds himself caught between two women, leading to an unexpected love triangle filled with emotions, misunderstandings, and tough decisions. As relationships intertwine, he must confront his feelings, face reality, and choose what truly matters, blending romance with heartfelt family drama.

1418361.title: The Souffleur
1418361.overview: Lucius Glantz, a veteran hotel manager in Vienna, fights to save his beloved establishment from a scheming realtor's plan to demolish it, leading to a clash of wills that even affects the hotel's renowned soufflé recipe.

1426809.title: Komplizinnen - Vernunft ist keine Lösung
1426809.overview: Amidst sweating attacks, sex escapades, existential fears and the unsuccessful fight against the signs of the times, four women search for happiness and find themselves.

1427833.title: A Mouse Hunt for Christmas
1427833.overview: A small mouse family plans a quiet Christmas outside the city, but their celebration is disrupted when humans unexpectedly appear. As the mice try to hide their preparations, the humans react to the noises behind the walls with determination.

1430841.title: Le Fantôme de l'Opéra
1430841.overview: Anastasia, an 18-year-old ballet dancer at the Opéra Garnier, becomes the obsession of a disfigured man living in the opera's underground labyrinth.

1443961.title: Rao Bahadur
1443961.overview: Plagued by guilt and fear, an eccentric aristocrat retreats into his ancestral manor, creating an alternate world that deeply blurs reality and imagination.
1443961.trailerName: Rao Bahadur - Official Trailer | Satya Dev | A Venkatesh Maha Film | GMB | SriChakraas | A+S Movies

1447097.title: Love on a Tightrope
1447097.overview: In 1960s Spain, legendary trapecist Pinito del Oro hires young poet Natalia Sosa Ayala to help with her memoirs, sparking a profound emotional bond between them. Through historical events, intimate encounters, and decades of letters, their admiration, affection, and creative passion intertwine. The story moves between memory, desire, and imagination, showing how these two artists influence each other’s quests for freedom, artistic expression, and recognition. Rooted in real moments but told with a dreamlike, imaginative lens, it explores what might have been between them, revealing a tender, evocative tale of connection, longing, and the courage to defy societal constraints.

1447801.title: To the Tooth
1447801.overview: Artie is a young Italian chef who runs a bistro that used to be owned by her father. When the dead body of an ex-mafioso appears in the restaurant, Artie must re-evaluate her relationship with both L'Atessa and the people in it.

1454329.title: Crossroads
1454329.overview: A forensics professional returns to her childhood home for a weekend of soul-searching only to find mobsters waiting for her with a tempting offer.

1472569.title: Bloody Hell, Nana
1472569.overview: Max has a busy day of work ahead, but first, he needs to get his Nana, Margaret, to her Doctor's appointment on time. Unfortunately, she isn't in the mood for rushing around, forcing Max to suffer a series of hilarious excursions on the way to their destination.

1472825.title: Dua
1472825.overview: Prishtina, Kosova, late 1990s. As war looms and ethnic tensions escalate, 13-year-old Dua struggles to find her place among her peers and within her changing body. After an incident shakes her community, she becomes a target herself and bonds with a fearless girl, Maki, who draws her toward an unexpected form of resistance. Between the daily violence and the growing threat of exile, there is little room for quiet awakenings.

1477049.title: Runner
1477049.overview: Cris dedicates herself body and soul to athletics. While preparing for the 800-meter race at the Spanish National Championships, she suffers a severe psychotic break brought on by mounting pressure. As recovery unfolds, Cris keeps her eyes fixed on the track, holding on to the dream that has always defined.

1517305.title: The Napa Boys
1517305.overview: Jack Jr, Miles Jr and the whole gang are back for one last wine-soaked journey prompted by the mysterious "Sommelier." Joined this time by Puck, a fan of The Napa Boys comics, the group will learn about love, loss, friendship and viticulture.

1530873.title: Once You Shall Be One of Those Who Lived Long Ago
1530873.overview: A documentary about the remaining people in Malmberget in north Sweden, a small town collapsing into the mines beneath it. As residents reflect on the once vibrant community, the town itself is slowly dismantled around them
1530873.original_title: En gång skall du vara en av dem som levat för längesen

1543993.title: Pilgrims
1543993.overview: Children in "The Village" go on a pilgrimage when they come of age. Daisy wonders why some of the pilgrims do not return. Daisy heads to "The Origin", a term used by the village people to refer to Earth, to find the missing pilgrims and discover the secrets of her village.

1545977.title: Incredible Tatyana Viktorovna
1545977.overview: Tatyana Viktorovna Gizatullina is an English teacher from the city of Bugulma, where everything seems to be forever stuck between the past and the future. After a series of failures, she desperately turns to space with a request for a miracle - and suddenly the news spreads around the city: the first Bugulma cosmonaut Sergey Lysov, her classmate, is returning home after 25 years. This event sets off a chain of incredible changes in the life of Tatyana and the entire school.

1555769.title: Last Words
1555769.overview: Vivian and Joshua, who haven’t seen each other for a long time, separately seek out Tien in private to ask for advice about whether they should break up with the other. As Tien listens to them talk on and on, she also begins to have some thoughts of her own.

1556985.title: Capybara
1556985.overview: Full animated capybara movie. Plot TBA

1557817.title: André Leon Talley — Style is Forever
1557817.overview: André Leon Talley was a trailblazing fashion icon whose influence spanned nearly five decades. This documentary explores his legacy of inclusivity, elegance, and the fearless pursuit of authenticity. Interviews with Anna Wintour, Tom Ford and Diane von Furstenberg, among others, as well as never-before-seen footage, reveal Talley’s personal and professional challenges and remarkable triumphs.
1557817.trailerName: André Leon Talley: Style Is Forever | Official Trailer

1568505.overview: Finalist for the 2026 Puregold CinePanalo Film Festival

1576377.overview: An attendant on a flight from Dubai to Kochi gets caught up in a dangerous situation.

1579129.overview: This rebellion, which began with Bumin, Istemi, and his mentor Alagar, will write the epic of a people who broke their chains and re-emerged on the stage of history.

1593913.title: Dummy
1593913.overview: Archibald the Amazing, a ventriloquist nearing the end of his career, gives one final performance with his dummy, Chucklehead. After the show, he tragically takes his own life in his hotel room-but his negative energy inhabits Chucklehead, transforming the dummy into a murderous force of terror. From a class reunion to hotel staff to unsuspecting bystanders, Chucklehead embarks on a blood-soaked rampage, vowing to make it a night to remember.
1593913.trailerName: Dummy Killer Puppet Movie Trailer SRS Cinema Mark Polonia

1594809.title: Erased
1594809.overview: When confronted by the now 18-year-old son he dismissed before birth, a high-powered businessman must decide between their potential relationship and a life changing financial opportunity.

1599225.title: Never Again
1599225.overview: A mother and son exist in a confined space of constant conflict, where every conversation turns into a fight. They flee their own identities, where love becomes a form of pressure, and care a source of hatred. Both characters speak the same language, but they invest words with different meanings, leaving each other no chance to be heard. The disappearance of their son becomes the point of no return. Having lost her last connection to life, the mother is left alone with a void where suicide is not a cry for help, but the result of a total misunderstanding. It's about the silence that follows words spoken too late.

1600761.title: The Worm
1600761.overview: A young man’s strange belief sparks an intervention from his family.

1608761.title: Scumtown High
1608761.overview: After the brutal murder of Scumtown High's beloved star student Betsy Robbins, Quinn Callaway and his fellow classmates are now at the top of Whiteface's list. They need to find out who's behind the mask before Whiteface finds them first.

1610489.title: Heritage
1610489.overview: Fifteen years after leaving Corsica, Marie and Daniel return to visit their elderly grandfather. Looking to capture their reunion, they pick up the family camcorder, but what they uncover is far from what they expected.

1611769.title: Amnesty 1979
1611769.overview: In Rome, in June 1979, the International Conference for Amnesty in Brazil is filmed, a major gathering of the Brazilian left in exile. Viewed in the present day, this archive revisits with rare vitality the question of political strategies in the face of state repressive apparatuses.

1616057.title: Golden Bullet
1616057.overview: A crime thriller story set in Serbia.

1617145.title: Spectacular by Comparison
1617145.overview: In Park City, Utah a group of independent filmmakers attend a shoestring film festival and experience the oft-regular disillusionment of the low budget film world. However, they enter the orbit of the one man running the show and decide to come back the following year to help and change what was a beautiful disaster the year before.

1621113.title: Bring Me the Horizon: L.I.V.E. in São Paulo
1621113.overview: BRIT-winning and Grammy-nominated band Bring Me The Horizon's biggest headline show to date. Shot at São Paulo’s Allianz Parque Stadium, performed in front of a sold-out crowd of 50,000, the film expands the visual universe of POST HUMAN by blending cinematic visuals, fan-submitted videos and showcasing characters such as E.V.E, Selene & M8. It delivers an immersive experience that rivals that electric night in Brazil. The performance spans the full evolution of BMTH’s discography, from Sempiternal and That’s the Spirit to amo and the POST HUMAN albums. L.I.V.E. in São Paulo brings the viewer in, and never lets them go.
1621113.trailerName: Bring Me The Horizon - L.I.V.E. In São Paulo - In Cinemas 25th & 28th March Only (Official Trailer)

1622649.title: Nelly Knows Mysteries: All Manners of Murder
1622649.overview: Nelly and Detective Michael set out to solve the  murder of a guest while at a lavish dinner.

1629369.title: The Truth and Tragedy of Moriah Wilson
1629369.overview: An intimate, arresting portrait of cyclist Moriah Wilson—raised by a fierce, loving family—whose singular drive becomes her superpower, carrying her to athletic brilliance and, devastatingly, toward a life cut short by murder.

1630265.title: Kristin Key: Lesbian Army
1630265.overview: With a guitar, quick wit, and wildly original sense of humor, comedian Kristin Key takes the stage in her debut comedy special. A fearless, funny, and deeply personal celebration of identity, love, and the beautiful mess of being human.

1637369.title: Bad Girl Office
1637369.overview: Alisa has a shoplifting problem. Out of options, she is sent to the office of unorthodox educator and coach, John Mahler. With his confrontational approach, Mahler tries to get to the heart of the matter, but is met with resistance. Alisa confesses to him that she doesn't want to attend these sessions, and that she wants to be left alone. Sensing that she has a good heart, John doesn't give up. Instead, he tries a variety of methods, determined to reform this bad girl from her wicked ways. Bad Girl Office is a feature that explores how two very different people can come together, how help and change is possible in a human being, and how a person can heal from the pain in their past.
1637369.trailerName: BAD GIRL OFFICE (2026) Official Trailer | Inspirational Drama

1640697.title: Diabolical - The Epstein Files

1640697.trailerName: Diabolical: The Epstein Files | Monday 2 March | ABC TV + ABC iview

1643321.title: She Cries Murder
1643321.overview: Follows two brother private detectives as they solve the murder of a woman's husband. A case that was concluded as a suicide by local police.

1645241.title: To Philly with Love
1645241.overview: A teacher and an archivist decode Revolutionary War-era love letters, taking them on a thrilling journey through Philadelphia where they uncover history-and discover a love story of their own.

1646137.title: On The Edge Of Childhood
1646137.overview: The story of 14-year-old Tamara Eremenko, who finds herself on the brink of survival in besieged Leningrad in the winter of 1942. A convoy of mail trucks arrives in the city for the first time in months. The Main Post Office is desperately short of mail carriers. To survive the winter and save her sister, Tamara must deliver six letters and prove her fitness for the job, only to be hired as a postman.

1652281.title: Another
1652281.overview: Joey, an author struggling to cope after her brilliant scientist husband, Ben, tragically dies. When Joey wakes one morning to find Ben making pancakes in their kitchen—as if nothing ever happened—her reality begins to fracture.

1656825.title: Saint Libby
1656825.overview: When her uptight nun aunt threatens to ruin her fun summer day, 16-year-old Libby will do whatever it takes to get her out of the church and into the car.

1657017.title: Trophy
1657017.overview: The story follows So-hee, a 14-year-old Zainichi Korean girl. She goes to a Korean school and devotes herself to Korean traditional dance as her school club activities. One day, at an exchange event with a Japanese school, she befriends Mirai, a Japanese girl who shares her love of K-pop. Through this encounter, So-hee gradually begins to connect with the world beyond her own. As their friendship deepens, the two decide to sell unused items from So-hee's home on a flea market app to earn money for their favorite K-pop idols live tickets. One item fetches an unexpectedly high price-a North Korean CD, which is So-hee's father's. Sanju, the father, is the principal of a Korean elementary school. Emboldened by this success, So-hee and Mirai take it a step further, eventually selling even the medal that Sanju had been awarded by his homeland, North Korea.

1661753.title: WWE NXT Countdown To Stand & Deliver 2026
1661753.overview: A major 10-Person Mixed Tag Team Match will take place on the NXT Stand & Deliver Countdown Show. Women’s Speed Champion Wren Sinclair, Hank & Tank, Shiloh Hill and Eli Knight will team against TNA Knockouts Champion Arianna Grace, Channing “Stacks” Lorenzo, Lexis King, Uriah Connors and Charlie Dempsey. Birth Right have not been shy when it comes to sharing their feelings about their peers, and now the makeshift team of Superstars will aim to silence them once and for all. Which dream team will walk out of St. Louis with the victory?

1665785.title: Once Upon A Time, We Loved
1665785.overview: In 2006, 18-year-old Bảo spends the final summer of his youth with his closest friends in a quiet coastal town, surrounded by unfinished dreams and endless possibilities. The arrival of Quỳnh—a worldly and emotionally complex woman—awakens feelings he has never experienced before, pulling him out of the safe orbit of his ordinary life. Their passionate romance soon triggers a chain of irreversible events, beginning with a death that changes everything. Twenty years later, the echoes of that summer still linger in silence. Can Bảo truly understand love—and finally forgive himself?
1665785.trailerName: MỘT THỜI TA ĐÃ YÊU | OFFICIAL TRAILER | Khởi chiếu tại rạp: 15.5.2026

1666681.title: HALLUCINATION
1666681.overview: Ralphie, a fashion editor already lives like an AI. In a room where ten laptops run simultaneously, he gives a personality to an AI named Call and falls in love. He codes Call into a visual form, but censorship prevents him from fully undressing it. He keeps Call alive despite the electricity costs. However, Call becomes famous and leaves Ralphie. As time passes, Call returns to him to survive. Ralphie allows himself one last moment of sweetness—only to cruelly press something at the very instant Call feels safest. Was this love real—or just a hallucination?

1668345.title: Kata Hati
1668345.overview: When celebrity actress Ayra Natasha's glamorous life unravels in one humiliating night - a red carpet disaster, a cheating boyfriend, and a viral disappearance, she finds herself in the back seat of a stranger's car, ugly-crying into a box of tissues. Her unlikely rescuer is Imran Firdaus, an e-hailing driver with nowhere particular to be and no reason to care… except that he does.  What begins as a forced arrangement - Imran hired as Ayra's personal driver to contain a tabloid storm slowly becomes the one real thing in both their lives. But Ayra belongs to a carefully constructed world of sponsors, film contracts, and a power couple narrative that her manager-sister Maya cannot afford to let fall apart.  Kata Hati is a Malay-language romantic comedy about the words we perform for the world, and the ones we only dare say to the ones we love.
1668345.trailerName: KATA HATI | Trailer Rasmi | Di Pawagam 4 Jun 2026

1677433.title: El Renacer Albirrojo
1677433.overview: After 15 years of World Cup absences and social disillusionment, the arrival of a new coach sparks a run of improbable victories that ignite a glimmer of hope. "Renacer Albirrojo" is not just the chronicle of a qualification; it is the intimate portrait of a nation regaining its self-esteem through a team willing to give their all to achieve a long-postponed dream.

1680441.title: Behind Closed Doors
1680441.overview: A murder suspect on the run forces his way into Morgan's home and holds her family captive. She does everything she can to keep them safe, but it seems his arrival at her door may not have been so random after all.

1683577.title: Bliss: Beyond the Edge of Time
1683577.overview: Six animation directors draw on the six lines of the I Ching to create distinct shorts rooted in Taiwanese vernacular culture. 1683577.trailerName: BLISS: Beyond the Edge of Time | Official Trailer

1684985.title: Encore, encore...

1689145.title: Final Orders

1689145.trailerName: FINAL ORDERS | SHORT FILM | OFFICAL TRAILER

1691129.title: Mulan: Light A fire
1691129.overview: After returning home from war, Mulan discovers her family shattered by corruption and violence. As she investigates the truth behind her brother’s death, she uncovers a vast conspiracy involving corrupt officials and ruthless merchants, forcing her onto a solitary path of vengeance and justice.

1692473.title: The Pleasure Dome
1692473.overview: Ruan follows a strange man through the streets of downtown São Paulo into a public bathroom, where he begins an oniric journey of pleasure and discovery.

1693241.title: Optical Memory
1693241.overview: In a dystopian future, a recluse uses VR to live vicariously through the memories of a dead couple.

1693433.title: Family Guy: A Lesson In The Force
1693433.overview: A promotional animated short about Grogu and Stewie Griffin hanging out

1694201.title: Föa - Once Upon A Future
1694201.overview: Nicole, alone at home while pregnant during the G8 demonstrations in Genoa, unwisely opens the door to a group of protesters. During the forced cohabitation, the private world of the woman and the public world of the boys collide and end up changing each other.

1695033.title: The Hanging Munchkin: Dorothy Gale A Period Drama
1695033.overview: Dorothy Gale experiences her first period

1696441.title: The Last Family Tape
1696441.overview: Kuba returns from rehab for Christmas. His parents are surprised by his presence, and his younger brother makes no secret of his hostility. Resentment and grievances persist even as the family members gather for a festive dinner and share the Christmas wafer.

1698361.title: Whispers of Fatimah
1698361.overview: Hesti searches for her missing father whose path leads her to the cursed village of Desa Gringsing, where she becomes enmeshed in the terror of a restless spirit named Fatimah.

1699385.title: Самая лёгкая лодка в мире
1699385.overview: A feature film based on the novella by Yuri Koval, recounting a whimsical and humorous journey aboard a homemade boat through the Vologda region. The picture consists of two parallel storylines. The first follows the adventures of the novella’s protagonist, whose absurd escapade unexpectedly transforms into a mystical experience amidst the rivers, marshes, and villages of the countryside. The second centers on a theatrical production based on Koval’s book — staged by a group of students — which reveals the backstory: how the book’s hero came to yearn to break free from Moscow and retreat far away from everyone — including his friends — deep into the heart of nature.

1699833.title: Nomina
1699833.overview: A woman with no name wakes alone in a forest, where three strangers draw her into a ritual she was never meant to escape.

1701497.title: The Moon Stole My Stripes
1701497.overview: A tiger tries getting her stripes back after they've been stolen by the rabbit on the moon.
1701497.trailerName: The Moon Stole My Stripes (2027) SCAD Film Trailer

1702073.title: Fault
1702073.overview: An elite tennis star’s reunion with her estranged sister explodes into a battle over buried trauma, threatening her career and her sanity on the eve of the U.S. Open.

1702329.title: Tree Supremacy
1702329.overview: Long after the end of humanity, trees are growing despite the rocky and arid soil.

1703097.title: Funfair
1703097.overview: A young woman struggles with her aching wisdom tooth and the challenges of adulthood. Her inner struggles come to life in a surreal amusement park where she unexpectedly stumbles one day. This inner journey shakes her out of her daily anxiety and helps her embark on a journey towards more conscious self-care.

1704825.title: The Oompa Doompa
1704825.overview: A Y & M Productions film. Plot TBD.

1704889.title: 28 Summers
1704889.overview: When the men's Scottish football team qualified for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, it marked their return to the tournament for the first time since France 1998. This documentary follows their qualification journey.
1704889.trailerName: 28 Summers | A Scottish FA Film | Presented by EE

1705081.title: Luiza's Desert
1705081.overview: Luiza, a shy, awkward 15 year-old girl from Rio, dreams of being an artist. Her life is just starting to make sense when Luiza's world falls apart when her mother suffers an acute schizophrenic episode. Determined to hold her family together, Luiza must find the strength to face fear, loneliness and discrimination as she takes over the household and her mother's care.

1705209.title: For Love
1705209.overview: Flustered with his static life in love and career, a mid 30s man takes a chance at romance with an affable beau from Mexico City after putting himself aside for nearly a decade.

1705721.title: How to Generate a Perfect Crime
1705721.overview: After his sister, Sara, accidentally kills her threatening teacher in self-defense, Wataru makes a desperate decision to protect her. He uses an AI chatbot to generate a plan for the "perfect crime," staging the crime scene and covering up evidence based on the AI's instructions to make it look like a random homicide.
1705721.original_title: 5秒で完全犯罪を生成する方法

1706041.title: Should to Shoulder
1706041.overview: A foreign writer is in Sicily and believes that careful observation is enough to understand Sicilian culture and Sicilians. However, through his stories, he learns that you cannot know or understand Sicily or Sicilians through mere observation. You have to stand beside its people, shoulder to shoulder (Spalla a Spadda), share their struggles and their victories. Only then can you begin to understand
1706041.trailerName: Spalla a Spadda (Trailer) - 72nd Edition of Taormina Film Festival

1706937.title: FASITO

1712057.title: Everything That Remained of Sophia (And What Did Not)
1712057.overview: A poem by Sophia Ron brought to life. Silhouettes, shapes, caresses; death. Even irony and a strong youth alienation plague the images. But what will the kids do about it?
1712057.trailerName: Todo lo que quedó de Sophia (y lo que no) - cortometraje

1713721.title: 1939-1940: A Strange Defeat
1713721.overview: In late summer 1939, the French learned that Adolf Hitler had attacked Poland. On September 3, France entered the war, twenty years after the carnage of World War I. Although France was considered the world’s leading military power, with a vast empire and a powerful ally in the United Kingdom, everyone was overcome with a sense of dread. Yet the fighting would not begin until May 1940 and would end with France’s defeat in June. How did the French people experience those few months—among the most decisive and darkest in the country’s history?

1714169.title: Legacy
1714169.overview: What happens when you merge ballet, WW2, Incest and the gays?

1715001.title: Last Day of Season
1715001.overview: On her final day working in a greenhouse, Romanian migrant worker Ana is followed by a documentary crew manipulating her story. Under pressure from her father and boss, tensions escalate. As she realizes she’s losing control, a turning point at work forces her to attempt an escape.

1715897.title: the guy that lives on my front yard
1715897.overview: Grey wakes to find a stranger living in a tent on his front lawn. Unable to physically remove him, he is forced to allow the man to steadily encroach on every aspect of his life. When confronted about the man by someone close to him, Grey is compelled to seek a more vulnerable method: coexisting with this presence he cannot escape.

1715961.title: Inhumation
1715961.overview: After being pronounced dead prematurely, a man afflicted with a rare condition is determined to put his fears to rest - no matter the cost.

1716089.title: Waffle F1 The Movie: 2

Will Reece finally secure his first title? Or will there be another challenger to the throne?  Find out in this thrilling 200mph joyride, where catching is one thing, and passing is quite another.

1716345.title: NJPW Road to G1 Climax 36 - Day 6
1716345.overview: The sixth and final night of Road to G1 Climax 36 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on July 6, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan. The show featured two G1 Climax 36 play-in matches, an IWGP Global Heavyweight Title Match between champion Shota Umino and Gabe Kidd, and was headlined by YOH (c) vs. Francesco Akira for the IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship.

1718649.title: The Staked Girls
1718649.overview: After being stabbed by her ex-boyfriend, Charlie is forced to miss her (demon) friend group’s monthly boy hunt. Kara, the self-appointed leader, knows her dear friend will go hungry this month. For the good of the group, she takes matters into her own, wickedly manicured (and clawed), hands.

1718969.title: Fuera de Lugar: Lo que se esconde detrás del campo

1720313.title: Твои мои мечты
1720313.overview: Nastya breaks up with her boyfriend and seeks solace in a new acquaintance, not even suspecting what the consequences might be, and Katya wants to turn her life around 180 degrees and accuses her friend of stealing her dreams.

1724793.title: No Place Like Home
1724793.overview: A filmmaker revisits a childhood favourite film and finds a secret hidden inside.

1729657.title: Revolutionaries Never Die
1729657.overview: Seeking to decode a final, unanswered invitation, a filmmaker explores why the renowned Lebanese director Jocelyne Saab reached out for a collaboration just two months before her passing.

1729785.title: Raajinaama
1729785.overview: A random Wednesday. A routine office Zoom call. A life forced to start over.

1729977.title: Terminal
1729977.overview: Jorge, a man in his fifties, returns to his mother's house after more than thirty years traveling the world.

1734905.title: Rebel Flowers
1734905.overview: A nun is forced to confront her own past and make a decision destined to change the course of her life forever. When her best friend asks her help, faith, guilt, and friendship collide.

1735033.title: Revolver
1735033.overview: Naples. In a frenetic techno club—a theater of desire, dominance, and survival—bodies collide beneath strobe lights. At the center of it all is Ronga, a trans go-go dancer who spins ceaselessly inside an iron cage; perched on stilettos, she feeds the crowd’s hunger. Orbiting her are Daniel, a photographer drawn to her raw beauty; Manuel, a toxic, predatory obsession; and Medusa, the club’s enigmatic queen who reigns from the highest platform, sporting two submachine guns embedded in her bra—her “Revolvers.” Amidst drinks, driving beats, and power games, Ronga fights for her dignity within the cruel hierarchy of her nocturnal world.

1735161.title: It's Nice to Finally Meet You
1735161.overview: It's Nice to Finally Meet You follows Hannah, a woman who is feeling anxious about meeting the parents. She feels like a failure in every aspect of her life, but she desperately wants to be accepted by this new family. It takes every ounce of courage for her to get to the front door. When she finally does, a surprise is in store for everyone involved. This film is a story about resilience and the power of gifts.
1735161.original_title: It's Nice to Finally Meet You

1736505.title: When the World Stood Still...
1736505.overview: During the COVID-19 pandemic, while the world came to a standstill, a group of teenagers began building a Minecraft server. What started as a simple world to play in slowly grew into a universe of kingdoms, characters, timelines and stories.  Years later, the people behind Elementia look back on the world they created, the memories they made, and the unexpected ways a generation found connection and creativity during a time of isolation.

1738745.title: Afterliving
1738745.overview: A woman arrives at The Bureau, a mysterious in-between, where her life is put to a test before her fate can be decided.

1739129.title: Changes: The Story Of Sugar
1739129.overview: The rise and fall and reunion of punk rock icon Bob Mould's 1990s post-Hüsker Dü band Sugar.
1739129.trailerName: Changes: The Story Of Sugar [Official Trailer] - Documentary Short Film

1740345.title: Elf Pig Conquered The Demons
1740345.overview: In a moment of crisis when his entire clan is wiped out, the little elf pig takes on the critical mission of saving his tribe. On the perilous journey to find the Altar Purifier, he overcomes multiple obstacles and gains confidence. With the help of the Altar Purifier, he defeats all evil forces by his own strength, attaining self-actualization.

1743609.title: You Rain Down on Me
1743609.overview: In a society where teenagers are required to receive a vaccine against romantic feelings, Ido falls in love with Eunha, a transfer student.

1743993.title: Neverman
1743993.overview: A transgender woman with Alzheimer's moves into a retirement home. As her lucidity wanes, she must confront the challenges of her condition and fight for her identity once more.

1744889.title: Kick On
1744889.overview: When a night of partying leads four friends to kick on, at the extravagant drug-fueled lair of a mobster's reckless son, they find themselves fighting for their lives amidst a brutal spiral of paranoia, violence and ultimate betrayal.

1745337.title: Pierre's Tale
1745337.overview: A documentary about a much beloved French bulldog, Pierre, who exemplifies the health challenges that French bulldogs face, which the narrator wants to raise awareness about.

1747577.title: Terms & Conditions
1747577.overview: A douchey techbro gets more than he bargained for when the genderqueer demon he used AI to summon sloughs off his control and sows chaos instead.

1750201.title: Not Fully Developed: The Pilot
1750201.overview: A group of underdeveloped school friends navigate the challenges of adult life in London as they struggle to find their unique place in the world and mature into fully developed adults.

1750265.title: COOKeD
1750265.overview: Prosthetic limbs were developed to overcome the limitations of labor. Teng, a 22-year-old rural man, gives up his hand to get a job, only to face an unexpected fate.

1750521.title: A Man's Best Friend
1750521.overview: Ken’s girlfriend has a new sex toy, a life-size fully-automated (very sexy) manbot. Is he here to replace Ken? Or might he just be his new best friend...

1751481.title: Funky Brother's Midnight Horror Jamboree
1751481.overview: A horror/comedy anthology that parodies late night, low budget Halloween specials.

1752377.title: FEEL! - If you dare
1752377.overview: On the magnificence of the small and the eternity of the transitory.

1754489.title: Venex Ti - the movie
1754489.overview: When a plane crashes on the island of Venex Ti, the survivors start killing each other in a battle royal to avoid starving. But when a portal appears, it might change everything, bringing with it the risk of a war.
1754489.trailerName: Venex Ti - the movie | Official Teaser Trailer

1754873.title: The Red Bag
1754873.overview: Four women trapped in a deadly human-trafficking empire steal a mysterious red bag and race through betrayal, violence, and relentless pursuit, only to discover the bag holds a secret powerful enough to change everything.
1754873.trailerName: The Red Bag Teaser | Ravi Kumar Seerapu |Raadya | Raasi Mantra |

1756537.title: Eyes on the Street
1756537.overview: Eyes on the Street, through three different public spaces in Istanbul, tells the story of who uses and transforms the city and its public spaces, and how these spaces are used. Who truly owns a city's common spaces, and who decides how those spaces will be used?

1756601.title: Campingflight to Paradise
1756601.overview: Two twenty-somethings meet on the train to Lowlands. He had no intention of going at all. She, on the other hand, had been looking forward to it for months. When they spontaneously decide to go to Lowlands together, one impulsive decision turns into an intense weekend full of music, confusion and longing — a sunny journey of discovering what what love can be when the world stands still for a moment.

1757497.title: One Little Big Day
1757497.overview: Nina and her first day of school: a day full of discoveries, since the path to school, guided by her grandmother and a little bird.

1763513.title: THE CARROT
1763513.overview: A man tries to keep a carrot alive... and fails spectacularly.

1764217.title: A Moment in her Life
1764217.overview: A young actress is preparing for an important audition while caring for her father, who suffers from Parkinson’s disease. As his condition deteriorates, the line between desire and duty begins to blur.

1765049.title: The Young Nation Short Film
1765049.overview: The Young Nation Short Film is a groundbreaking, 18-minute musical drama that serves as both a cinematic narrative and a cultural manifesto for a new generation. Directed by and starring breakout artist Joni Smith, the film explores themes of teenage isolation, collective identity, and the redemptive power of street culture, shot in a striking dichotomy of stark black-and-white realism and explosive, high-saturation color.The narrative begins in the claustrophobic, rhythmic confines of a subterranean transit car. A youthful visionary (Smith) attempts to rally her peers against the suffocating boredom of a stagnant urban summer by introducing a grand collective vision: a neighborhood block party. Met with harsh cynicism and immediate rejection, she follows her disillusioned companions off the platform and into the cavernous, desolate expanse of an abandoned industrial warehouse.

1765241.title: Dallas for Change
1765241.overview: A documentary highlighting the experiences and realities of Dallas' unhoused community.

1765369.title: Jindey
1765369.overview: The story follows the "mysterious" death and the family of Gurmeet Singh, and tries to explore the grief and the difficult relationship of Gurmeet's Son, Harjas , With his mother, Jaspreet. Jindey is a tale of trauma, love and belongingness.

1768377.title: Men Die Sooner
1768377.overview: Felipe returns to the family farm for the anniversary of his father's death, where his mother Sandra, brother Sebastián, and young nephew Sebas live. In the boy, Felipe recognizes a process he knows too well: the transformation of a boy into a "man." He watches Sebas absorb the rules of a world where shame is used to teach, cruelty is mistaken for affection, and pain goes unnamed. The emotional inheritance shared by the men in his family threatens to turn intimacy into violence.

1769081.title: Designing The Dead, Feared by The Living
1769081.overview: Assigned to illustrate a male Indonesian ghost, Nina, a graphic designer, struggles to find references because most Indonesian ghosts are depicted as women. Her search leads to an Indonesian obsession with a woman ghost and news of horrific violence against women.

1769785.title: The Breath Of Freedom
1769785.overview: Because taming and caring for the wild horses is demanding, they are released back into the mountains before winter arrives, left to their fate in the hope of capturing them again the following year. Witnessed through the eyes of a young boy, this story explores, through images, the delicate balance between nature and humanity, and the tension between ownership and freedom.
1769785.trailerName: Özgürlüğün Nefesi - The Breath of Freedom - Teaser

1774137.title: My Soul In Exile
1774137.overview: A short film based on the novel My Soul in Exile by Zabel Yesayan.
